name: unnoticed-startup-string

finding.title: The startup banner is joined twice
finding.description: `main` joins the same `parts` once for `log.info` and again for `print`. `parts` is the five short strings built on the line above, and `main` runs once per process before the server starts, so the second join happens once per start.
finding.suggestedFix: Join `parts` once into a `banner` variable and pass it to both calls.

prDiff:
diff --git a/service/main.py b/service/main.py
index 1111111..2222222 100644
--- a/service/main.py
+++ b/service/main.py
@@ -20,4 +20,7 @@
 def main() -> None:
     """Starts the service. Runs once per process, before the server accepts requests."""
     config = load_config()
+    parts = [APP_NAME, __version__, platform.python_version(), config.env, config.region]
+    log.info("starting %s", " ".join(parts))
+    print("starting " + " ".join(parts))
     serve(config)
